654-RC1 -- WHY THE DEADLOCK-FREEDOM CLAIM IS TRUE AND NOT A COINCIDENCE, measured rather than read off the report. (a) clara.documents carries FORCE row level security with 4 policies, and p_documents_owner is 'to clara_fn_owner using (true)' -- so the guard's new `select 1 from clara.documents ... for key share` inside the SECURITY DEFINER body genuinely SEES and therefore genuinely LOCKS the row (## S0.fn_owner_sees_document => {rows:1}, and the locking statement assigns an xid: ## S0.fn_owner_row_lock_taken => transactionid/ExclusiveLock). (b) EVERY live writer of clara.document_filings takes the documents row lock BEFORE the filings insert, swept off pg_proc on the rig, not assumed: clara._file_document_write ('select firm_id into v_doc_firm from clara.documents where id = p_document for update' at prosrc 1025, insert at 4294), clara.finalize_document_intake ('select * into d from clara.documents where firm_id=i.firm_id and sha256=i.sha256 for update' at 1361, insert at 7028), clara.confirm_attribution_candidate (1803 < 2478) and clara.approve_wrong_client_correction (2555 < 11445) -- the two 0027 fixed, whose order 0027's own tail still asserts by position -- plus clara._seed_verified_document, which INSERTS a fresh clara.documents row and is granted to clara_fn_owner ALONE (proacl {clara_fn_owner=X/clara_fn_owner}), so no application role reaches it and no contention is possible on a row it just created. (c) BOTH filing doors route into that locking body: clara.file_document -> _file_document_write, and clara.wake_file_document -> clara._agent_file_document_core -> _file_document_write (neither inserts directly). So the order 0205 §F now states (documents -> advisory) is the order every real lane already takes
